admissibility_rule.statement: An object with axis-aligned bounding box (dx, dy, dz) is admissible iff dx <= max_admissible_dx AND dy <= max_admissible_dy AND dz <= max_admissible_dz. Orientation: dx=X, dy=Y (chamber axis 162.4..324.6), dz=Z (gravity). Test against the INNER throat (minimum cross-section), not the top opening.
